items.a: DronaHost offers managed WordPress hosting, business hosting, domain registration and business email with Google Workspace. We also design websites, run SEO work and build custom sites with React and Next.js. Hosting, domains and email come from one provider, so one support desk can see your whole setup. Ask us which service fits your business.

items.q: Will my website go offline during the migration?
items.a: No. Your current site keeps running while we transfer it to DronaHost. We ask your permission before we point your DNS, so nothing switches until you agree. Each hosting plan includes the move of one website, and the migration terms list what is covered and what is not covered.

items.q: Will my price increase at renewal?
items.a: No. You renew at the same price you started on, with no end date. The pricing policy explains how renewals work. Prices appear on the pricing page, where each plan lists its signup price and its renewal price together. Prices exclude tax. Customers in India pay GST at checkout.

items.q: What if DronaHost is not right for me?
items.a: Ask for your money back within 30 days of your order and we refund your hosting plan. The refund policy sets out the exact terms, including what it does not cover, such as domain registrations. Please read the policy before you buy, and ask us if anything is unclear.

A hosting plan does not include email. Business email is a separate service that runs on Google Workspace, so you add it only when you need it. You can also keep the email you use today, because your hosting and your email work independently of each other.

items.q: How do I log in to my DronaHost account?
items.a: Open the client area at my.dronahost.com and sign in with the email address you used when you ordered. From the client area you can manage your services, pay invoices and open a support ticket. If you cannot sign in, email support@dronahost.com and we will help you get back in.

items.q: How do I contact DronaHost support?
items.a: Open a support ticket from the client area or the contact page, or email support@dronahost.com. Support is open by ticket and email at any hour of any day. The support policy explains how support works and what to include in a request so we can help you faster.
